The '''Trade Federation Freighter''' was a small [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] used by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. It and its successor, the [[Trade Federation Superfreighter]] were both common around the time of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]].

==Characteristics==
Although unarmed, this class of freighters were equipped with [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]]. These freighters could also unload its cargo in flight, and some were known to be completely automated. They were also capable of docking with the larger [[Trade Federation Superfreighter]].<ref name="Star Wars: Starfighter" />

==History==
A number of these freighters were in a convoy that the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Nym/Legends|Nym]] [[Battle of Lok (32 BBY)|attacked]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] over [[Lok/Legends|Lok]]. A small convoy of two Trade Federation Freighters were carrying war supplies from [[Eos]] when they were caught in an [[Battle of Eos (Invasion of Naboo)|attack]] spearheaded by [[Rhys Dallows]] and [[Reti]]. The freighters countered by ejecting [[Mine/Legends|mines]] but were still destroyed. Later, freighters of this type were part of another convoy that was [[Skirmish over Naboo|destroyed]] over [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] by Nym and his allies.<ref name="Star Wars: Starfighter" />

By [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], these freighters were still a common sight in the [[Karthakk system]]. A large number of Trade Federation Freighters were seen leaving [[Mount Merakan]] carrying materials needed for the Trade Federation's production of [[Trihexalon]]. Nym and his fellow pirate [[Jinkins]] attacked the last of the freighters to leave the mountain. Not long after, three were seen at the [[Battle of Nod Kartha]] attempting to reach the [[Nod Kartha|planet]], but were destroyed by [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]].<ref name="Star Wars: Jedi Starfighter" />

==Behind the scenes==
Trade Federation Freighters appear in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Starfighter (video game)|''Star Wars: Starfighter'']] and its [[2002]] sequel, ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Starfighter]]''.
